ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’

ἐπιήνδανε: ἐπιανδάνω — please, be agreeable to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. (ἀνδάνω, augmented ἥνδανε)

ἐσθλά: ἐσθλός — good, noble, excellent; neut. acc. pl.
ἐσσὶ: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic ἐσσί (= Attic εἶ)

ἐτύχθη: τεύχω — make, bring about; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ‘came to pass’
ἐόντος: εἰμί — be; pres. part. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντος): ’being, alive’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑκάστου: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. gen. sg.

ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv. (distinct from the by-form ἔνδοθι, also ’within’)
ἔνεικαν: φέρω — bring; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἤνεγκαν): ’they brought’

ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.

ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἠέλιον: ἥλιος — sun; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted ἠέλιον (= Attic ἥλιον)
ἠλάκατα: ἠλάκατα — spun wool, yarn (neut. pl.; cf. ἠλακάτη ’distaff’); neut. acc. pl.

ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl. ’we’

ἥβης: ἥβη — youth, young manhood, prime of life; fem. gen. sg. (ἥβης μέτρον ’the measure of manhood’)
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἥμεναι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἧσθαι)
ἥμενος: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’

ἦα: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἦα (= Attic ἦν)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’

ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἰκαρίοιο: Ἰκάριος — Icarius, father of Penelope; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἰότητι: ἰότης — will, wish, favour; fem. dat. sg.: ’by the will of’
ἱκάνεις: ἱκάνω — come to, arrive at, reach; pres. 2 sg.
ἱμερόεσσαν: ἱμερόεις — lovely, desirable; fem. acc. sg.

ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἴφια: ἴφιος — stout, sturdy (the traditional gloss; ’fat’ also given); neut. acc. pl., with μῆλα

ἶρος: Ἶρος — Irus, the town beggar; masc. nom. sg.

ὁρώμενος: ὁράω (mid.) — look at, gaze toward; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.

ὄλβον: ὄλβος — prosperity, good fortune, happiness; masc. acc. sg.

ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅρμον: ὅρμος — necklace (from εἴρω ’string’); masc. acc. sg. · also ὅρμος — anchorage, roadstead (cf. ὁρμίζω ’bring to anchor’); masc. acc. sg.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’

ὑμετέροισι: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.), yours; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
ὑπερώϊα: ὑπερῷον — upper room, upper storey; neut. pl., epic ὑπερώϊα (= Attic ὑπερῷα), acc. of goal
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’

ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj.
